entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi... um, yes, I'm calling about an order. I bought a jersey a while ago and I think I need to send it back. I'm just so confused by the whole process on your website.
I can certainly help you with that. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference matter?

Oh, it's not damaged or anything. It's just the wrong size. I finally tried it on for a real ride and it's way too tight across the chest. I feel like I can't breathe. I don't really understand all the return rules. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I'm here to help. It sounds like you need to do an exchange for a different size. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, I think so... it's VF90210.
Thank you. Let me pull that up... One moment. Okay, I see your order for the Aero Race Jersey, placed about two months ago. Let me just confirm our policy.
Alright, I've checked everything. You are well within our 90-day return window, so we can absolutely get this sorted for you.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! I was so worried I was too late. I just couldn't figure it out on my own.
Not a problem at all. We can process this as an exchange for a larger size right now. I'm generating a prepaid return label and I'll email it to you. Does that sound good?
Yes, that's perfect! Thank you so much, Alex. You've made this so much easier.
You're very welcome. The email is on its way. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
